description.value: Yaki Joe's is a locally owned and independently operated pizza restaurant with locations in both Merritt and Kamloops, BC, known for stone-oven baking, made-from-scratch crusts, and a commitment to fully fresh, handmade ingredients. Beyond pizza, the menu spans calzones, wings, wraps, salads, and pastas — all made in-house with no packaged shortcuts. Travelling cyclists will find a sit-down restaurant with a kids menu, online ordering, and delivery available from 4 PM.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, active pizza restaurant with two locations (Merritt and Kamloops). The OSM phone +1-778-765-4646 matches the Kamloops number listed on the contact page, confirming this is the Kamloops location. The website does not list a specific street address for the Kamloops location (only 'Kamloops BC'), so the OSM address cannot be corroborated; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site, though takeout and online ordering are clearly offered.
concerns: OSM name contains a likely typo: 'Gormet' should probably be 'Gourmet' — preserved as-is per OSM rules.

The website (yakijoesmerritt.com) is branded for the Merritt location; the Kamloops location shares the site but has no dedicated page or street address listed — OSM address '302 Yellowhead Highway' cannot be confirmed from the website.
Two distinct locations (Merritt: 2190 Voght St; Kamloops: address unknown) share one website — ensure there is not a separate OSM record for the Merritt location using the same URL.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed by a live website with menu and ordering. A useful food stop for cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor through Kamloops.

wow_evidence: locally owned and independently operated pizza restaurant with locations in both Merritt and Kamloops
